confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 monsoon low-season window, based on general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable, accommodation varies widely by area and season, and the 3-star anchor is the least certain. The FX value is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA entry as reported in search results: I did not open the page, the search timestamps were inconsistent, and no second RBA page confirmed it. Search output also contained an unrelated embedded instruction about markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asian tourist-hub basis, using Thamel and Lazimpat as reference districts; no single named comparable city was used.
